title: First Spin
hints: That round tile is a turntable. It turns you as you step on.
Just walk. Count the steps to the lift.

story.intro: PATCH: "Twist. VANTA got into the Helix and set every turntable spinning. Step on one and it turns you a quarter turn."
story.outro: PATCH: "Three steps, one corner, and you never pressed turn. The tower did it for you."
